name: wizard_unit
before:
[Unit]
Description=sa-home-node (нода: супервизор служб роя)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/home/user-a/sa-home/data
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'true'
ExecStart=/home/user-a/.local/bin/sa-home-bot --service node --config /home/user-a/sa-home/config.toml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=300
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStopSec=150
Environment=PATH=/home/user-a/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
